summary: Frontend smoke tested all 5 surfaces in Phase 41 S4.5 (Announcement Coupons + Trivia Leaderboard). SURFACE 1 (Wallet Coupons), 2.A (StationPage Active Coupons + claim), 2.B (Top Brains Trivia Leaderboard), 2.C (Owner AnnouncementManager coupon editor) all PASS. SURFACE 3 (StationTV) renders all expected components but the coupon spotlight shows the active WALLET20 coupon instead of the sold-out KARAK15 the spec described — likely picking first/non-sold-out coupon by design, functional but a spec-vs-actual data deviation worth confirming.

issues: The clear/remove-coupon button is labelled 'Remove coupon' in the UI, but the request spec calls it 'Clear coupon'. Pure copy mismatch — functionality (removing a coupon from an announcement) works.

tv-coupon-spotlight renders 'SCAN TO CLAIM · 20% OFF · 🎟 WALLET20 · 99 left' instead of the KARAK15/Sold out scenario described in the spec. Looks like the component picks the first active coupon (or the not-sold-out one). Component itself functions; flag for product confirmation.

action_items: (Optional) Confirm StationTV CouponSpotlight selection rule — spec referenced KARAK15 (sold out) but actual picks WALLET20 (active). If KARAK15 is intended, fix selection logic in StationTV.jsx around the spotlight render block.
(Optional copy nit) AnnouncementManager owner edit row uses 'Remove coupon' label whereas review spec asked for 'Clear coupon'. Rename if you want the labels to match the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: CouponClaimModal copy-code button renders 'WALLET20 ' with a trailing space because the lucide icon is included in the same flex container without trimming — harmless visually but the test_id text content has a trailing whitespace; tighten with a wrapping {code} if you ever assert exact text equality.

Console flood: NavItem in Sidebar spreads a props object that contains a 'key' field — React warning 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX'. Pre-existing and unrelated to Phase 41 S4.5 but it spams every page navigation and should be cleaned up.
401 noise: /api/geo/me?tz=UTC and a couple of public listing calls 401 on first paint before auth header is attached. Not a regression for this session but worth a tiny retry-with-auth pass.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-seeded WALLET20 redemption (rd_12a8a82e5a574d) for demo + 12 game_sessions on p41-audit-test as described in the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 named surfaces (Wallet Coupons tab, StationPage Active Coupons + Trivia Leaderboard, TV ticker) plus the owner editor light-smoke surface are verified.
